name: Missouri

statute.name: Missouri Sunshine Law
statute.citation: Mo. Rev. Stat. ch. 610 (§§ 610.010-.030; response § 610.023.3; enforcement § 610.027)

response.rule_text: Each request must be acted on as soon as possible and no later than the end of the third business day after the custodian receives it; delay beyond three days is allowed for 'reasonable cause' with a written explanation of the cause and earliest date, Mo. Rev. Stat. § 610.023.3.

fees.labor_rule: Research time may be charged at actual cost (lowest-cost method); staff time capped at average hourly pay of staff of the body.
fees.copy_rule: Not over ten cents per page for paper copies up to 9x14 in; hourly duplication fee not over average clerical hourly pay.
fees.waiver_rule: Records may be furnished free or at reduced charge if the body finds waiver in the public interest because disclosure is likely to contribute significantly to public understanding.

residency.rule_text: Any member of the public may request; access is not limited to U.S., Missouri or local citizens, Mo. Rev. Stat. §§ 610.010-.030.

appeal.body: Circuit court of the county where the body has its principal place of business; AG may sue
appeal.rule_text: No express administrative appeal (informal appeal to a superior may help); suit lies in circuit court under Mo. Rev. Stat. § 610.027.1 and may be brought by any aggrieved person, taxpayer, the Attorney General or prosecuting attorney.

notes: Appeal deadline null (not found in fetched text). Executive and legislative branches are 'public governmental bodies' (§ 610.011). Silence-is-denial not extracted. Universities/school districts not confirmed as explicit rule.
